newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London weak, volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London weak, volumes thin.

text.p: Japanese shares were mostly lower in light trade by midday as investors paused for breath after sharp gains the previous two days, dealers said.
"The market is generally weaker. We've seen a dramatic rise the last two days and the market just wants to drift down a bit," said one dealer.
He said Wall Street's mixed performance overnight and a drop in Tokyo stocks earlier today was keeping many players sidelined.
"We haven't really seen a lot of business. What business there is has been in second-liners," the dealer said.

In Tokyo on Wednesday, the Nikkei 225 index closed down 153.84 points or 0.72 percent at 21,156.75, while in New York on Tuesday the Dow snapped a four-day winning streak, ending down 0.37 point at 5,888.3.
